simple.summary: שָׂפָם (sâphâm) means the beard (as a lip-piece ) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 19 25.

definitions.full: H8222. sapham שָׂפָם noun [masculine] moustache (compare N Syriac rete ; on meaning and form see Thes Ol 408 Kö ii. 73 ); — absolute ׳שׂ Micah 3:7 +, suffix שְׂפָמוֺ 2Sam 19:25 ; — moustache: שׂ ׳עָשָׂה 19:25 ( ᵐ5 μύστάξ ) i.e. trim it; עַלשֿׂ ׳עָטָה Micah 3:7 ; Ezek 24:17 , 22 ; Lev 13:45 (P; see I. עטה 1 ). שִׂמַּח see III. ספח . מִשְׂמָּח see II. ספח . ִשׂפְמוֺת 1Sam 30:28 see ׳שִׁפ . שׂפן see ספן . I. שֶׂ֫פֶק שׂפק, see ספק .
